spans.s: उक्त (I) a. (f. क्ता) 1. Addressed (as a person, e.g. अनुक्तेनापि वक्तव्यं सुहृदा हितमिच्छता; 2. said, spoken; 3. said (as op. to inferred), e.g. उक्तानि प्रतिषिद्धानि पुनः संभावितानि च.
उक्त (II) n. A word, a sentence, a speech.
उक्त (I) a. (f. क्ता) 1. Addressed (as a person, e.g. अनुक्तेनापि वक्तव्यं सुहृदा हितमिच्छता; 2. said, spoken; 3. said (as op. to inferred), e.g. उक्तानि प्रतिषिद्धानि पुनः संभावितानि च.
उक्त-अनुक्त a. spoken and not spoken.
उक्त-पुंस्क a. a feminine or neuter word of which also a masculine exists and whose meaning only differs from that of the masculine by the notion of gender (in gram.).
उक्ति f. 1. Speech, expression, M.viii.104; 2. the expressive power of a word, एकयोक्त्या पुष्पवंतौ दिवाकरनिशाकरौ Am.i.4.10.
